name: Demo 08: Survey feedback analyser (try it now)

parameters.content:
## Survey feedback analyser: try it now
Click **Test workflow**. It runs on 36 made-up survey responses and needs no accounts, keys or network.

Then click each node: the ratings worked out by code, the illustrative AI reply, the checks (counts, themes, word-for-word quotes, flags) and the report email (open the `html` field).

Lumen Teacher Training Academy is fictional.

### About the AI reply
Illustrative replies written for this demo, standing in for the live Claude call in the full version. They are not AI output.
